simple.meaning: קוֹל (qôwl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a voice or sound.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 506 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, beginning at Genesis 3:8. Its contexts include family, blood, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קוֹל (H6963).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קוֹל (qôwl) / H6963 is traced through Genesis 3:8, Genesis 3:10, Genesis 3:17, Genesis 4:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.
